thread:
ara: quick question about header behavior — if a request comes in with only Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> and no X-Redwood-Org/X-Redwood-Project, do we currently infer org from the key or reject? seeing some 401s from an older client.

sam: we used to infer org from legacy account-scoped keys, but that was supposed to be phased out. what client version? :thinking:

ara: client v1.9.2 (old mobile SDK). it used to work before yesterday. error is 401 invalid_auth.

maria: security note — we only keep backward inference for keys flagged as "legacy": the key metadata has `scope: account` vs `scope: project`. account-scoped keys still map to a single org but will stop being auto-inferred after rotation window.

ara: ok — is the rotation window enforced at auth check time or during key rollover? in other words, if a key was rotated at 2026-03-16T12:00Z, and the old key is marked deprecated for 48h, do we accept auth without explicit X-Redwood-Org for those 48h?

sam: current behavior: auth layer accepts the old key for 48h, and will still populate org from key binding if project header missing. but we made a small change to reject header-less requests if the key has been re-issued within the last 5m (safety guard for immediate swaps). that might explain yesterday's spike.

ara: ah that matches our traffic — multiple clients rotated almost simultaneously. can we get a log snippet or the exact decision tree?

sam: yes gist of decision tree:```
1) if Authorization missing -> 401
2) else validate key -> if invalid -> 401
3) if X-Redwood-Project present -> use project, ensure key has project scope or higher -> 403 if mismatch
4) else if X-Redwood-Org present -> use org, ensure key bound to org -> 403 if mismatch
5) else if key.scope == 'project' -> 403 (project-scoped key requires explicit project header)
6) else if key.scope == 'account' -> infer org from key binding, but reject if key.deprecated && now - deprecated_at > rotation_grace -> 401
```

maria: policy update: rotation_grace is 48h for normal rotations, 5m for immediate re-issues flagged as hot-swap. we added the 5m safe-fail to prevent double-swap race conditions.

lee: can we surface a clearer error code for the inferred-org rejection? currently it's just 401 invalid_auth which makes it hard for SDKs to suggest remediation. maybe `401 missing_scope_inferred_org_required` or add a `WWW-Authenticate` hint?

sam: agree. i can change to `401 missing_org_header` with a `hint` field in the auth error payload. will open a tiny PR. cc @ara for SDK work. :+1:

ara: thanks — i'll add client-side fallback: if we get that specific 401, prompt user to upgrade or attach `X-Redwood-Org`. also adding metrics so we can track how often old clients hit this.

devrel-bot: FYI docs update created: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/auth#headers — section "legacy keys and org inference" now lists rotation behavior. :book:

ops-bot: deploy pipeline: auth-service/rolling/2026-03-17-09 — started 1763267900, current status: canary healthy, rollout in progress.

sam: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/412 — changes: error code + hint. @maria can you do a quick security review?

maria: i'll take a look, should be quick. also please add a test for project-scoped keys rejecting header-less requests (caught one regression in staging yesterday).

lee: pinging eng-oncall to watch for 401 spikes after rollout. @eng-oncall :eyes:

ara: thanks all — i'm going to patch mobile SDK and ship a point release with an explicit header until most clients rotate. will post PR soon.

sam: sweet. follow-up action items: 1) sam -> open PR (done) 2) maria -> security review + test 3) ara -> SDK patch and metrics 4) ops -> monitor 5) docs -> note (done). will sync in async thread if anything odd shows up. :rocket:
